meta.turnover_convention: sum over sleeves |traded notional|/NAV (both legs); cost = bps x turnover

matched_pairs.note: F3m = TQQQ with the fine-grid voltgt whose IS maxDD is closest to F2's; F2m = QLD with voltgt whose IS maxDD is closest to F3's (QLD max reachable IS maxDD on the grid: -0.346). The instrument test holds TQQQ at exactly 2/3 of F2's QLD weight (max |exposure difference| = 4.44e-16), the freed 1/3 goes to IEF.

bootstrap.settings: paired circular block bootstrap, 63-day blocks, 1000 draws, IS 1988-01-01..2026-07-24

tranche_grid.note: same 18 configs, held as 5 weekday tranches (Mon..Fri rebalance phases averaged): removes rebalance-timing luck; matched-risk tables on a 0.025-step voltgt grid; bootstrap 600 paired draws

execution_lag.note: lag1 = weights from Friday-close signal earn returns from the next session, i.e. traded AT the Friday close (achievable only with a ~15:45 ET pre-close computation + market-on-close orders). lag2 = trade at the next session's close. 'stale_signal' = Thursday-close signal traded at Friday close (upper bound on the error of computing before the close). mark = Fridays only (holiday Fridays skip that week); mark_wk = last trading day of each week. Oct-1987 is before the 1988 stats start (shown as a stress test).

rebalance_weekday.note: Weekly rebalance on each weekday (holiday weeks skip, as P.mark does for Fridays), daily rebalance, and a 5-tranche book (each fifth rebalanced on a different weekday). Fri_lag1 is the research baseline. The tranche removes rebalance-timing luck and is the conservative planning estimate.

rebalance_band.note: Drift-faithful loop: holdings drift between rebalances (common.backtest instead re-sets target weights every day for free). band = absolute weight tolerance per sleeve; rebalance skipped when ALL sleeves are within the band; '_override' = always trade when the leveraged sleeve switches on/off. Costs are bps of NAV per unit of turnover (both legs). Fixed $1/order drag is an illustrative assumption (IBKR Pro Fixed minimum), shown for 25k/60k/150k accounts.

real_vs_sim.note: 2010-03-01..2026-11-17 (all four instruments real). Same weights; only the return columns differ. Gold = gold_phys (= GLD real) in every version. sim sleeves: qld_sim = 2*NDX price return - 0.95%/yr - rf, tqqq_sim = 3*NDX - 0.95% - 2rf (price index, no dividends, no swap spread); ief_syn/tlt_syn = yield-based duration/convexity models calibrated on the real ETFs (in-sample calibration over 2002-2026).

variants.note: every distinct backtest configuration (strategy x engine x lag x marks x band x cost x data version) counted once; fine grid = frontier mapping (not a selection search)
